name: seated bent knee to chest buttock stretch
description: Pulling a bent knee toward your chest to stretch the buttock muscles.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs out in front.
Bend one knee, hold it with both hands and gently pull it toward your chest.
Keep your back tall and avoid rounding it as you pull.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
